scoring_justification: Full recompute requires running DFT which is infeasible; score the trend ordering and compare values to paper gold with tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: paper-reported adsorption energies for each configuration
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: these are the paper's actual reported numbers, verified against the paper text

outputs.description: Computed DFT adsorption energies (eV) for NH3 and NO on the (MoO2)2+/HZSM-5 cluster. The checker compares each value to the hidden paper-reported values within a tolerance and verifies that all NH3 energies are more negative than all NO energies.

output_contract.notes: Only the LDA/PWC adsorption energies are scored. Extra columns or rows beyond the seven configurations are ignored.
